name: lup-web
description: The TypeScript surfaces lup serves locally, one Vite entry per surface, built into lup.web's package data.

scripts.typegen: json2ts --input schema/views.json --output src/generated/views.d.ts --unreachableDefinitions --bannerComment '/* Generated from lup.ledger.views by `bun run typegen`; edit the pydantic models, not this file. */'
scripts.build: bun run typegen && tsc --noEmit && NODE_ENV=production vite build
